ModMetaData.name: Stack Behaviour Overhaul
ModMetaData.author: Sir Rolin
ModMetaData.description:
Stack damage carries through a stack: when an item's health is depleted, that item is removed and remaining damage carries over. When part of a damaged stack is split off, the remaining stack is restored to full health.
Combining damaged stacks adds their damage instead of averaging it, potentially consuming items. Explosion damage to stackable items scales with stack size and a configurable setting.
Market value reflects one damaged item and the healthy remainder wherever item market value is used.
Trade interfaces show a damaged stack as one damaged item and a separate healthy remainder. These temporary trade splits are merged back together when the trade window closes.
